concerns.text: Task T017c (Unified Data Generation) lists dependencies on T019 (Serialization) and T021 (Logging). However, T019 and T021 are marked [P] (parallel) and placed AFTER T017c in the list. T017c cannot execute 'during the generation loop' if the serialization logic (T019) and logging (T021) it depends on have not been implemented yet. T019 and T021 must precede T017c.

Task T035a (OOD Detection) is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but explicitly depends on T022 (trained model moments). T022 is in Phase 4 (US2). A task cannot be parallel-safe if it requires the output of a previous phase's task to define its logic (statistical distance metric). The [P] tag is incorrect; this task must be ordered after T022.

Task T035b (Edge Case Handler) depends on T035a (OOD Detection) and T016b. T035a is marked [P] and placed before T035b, but T035a itself depends on T022 (Phase 4). The ordering implies T035a can run in parallel with US3 tasks, but it is blocked by US2 completion. The [P] tag on T035a and the implied parallelism of T035b are semantically invalid given the cross-phase dependency.

Task T005a (Pilot Sensitivity) depends on T005b (Epsilon values). While T005b is listed immediately before T005a, T005a is in Phase 2 (Foundational) but T025b (Full Sensitivity) in Phase 5 depends on T005a. The pilot task T005a is a prerequisite for the full analysis, but the ordering of T005a relative to the rest of Phase 2 (which includes data model tasks) is acceptable. However, the note 'Must complete before T030b' is correct, but the dependency chain T005b -> T005a -> T025b -> T033 is clear. No re-ordering needed, but ensure T005a is not marked [P] if it implies parallel execution with T005b (it is sequential).

Task T025b (Full Sensitivity Analysis) depends on T005b (Epsilon values) and T030b (Simulation results). T030b is in Phase 5, but T025b is also in Phase 5. The ordering lists T025b BEFORE T030b in the task list (T025b is listed before T030a/b/c). T025b requires the output of T030b (simulation results) to calculate error rates. T025b must be moved to AFTER T030b/T030c2.
